title: GAP-10: Top-level hazard classifier is a stub: six of nine F03.7 classes never reach the scoreboard
body:
[A10] Found by the compliance-matrix audit of `docs/00_MILAN_COMPLIANCE_REVIEW.md` at main 6a878f6 (owner request, 2026-09-18). The matrix Cov column grades the ORIGINAL architecture document; this ticket records what the tree carries today. Baseline at that head: `./scripts/run_suites.sh` exit 0 (30 of 30 suites, 14790 checks), `./scripts/lint_hdl.sh` exit 0.

## Finding

GAP-10 (Major), F00.2 verdict of this audit: **PARTIAL**.

- Resolution claimed in F00.2: CDC/reset, interface contracts, parameter table, profiles, grounded hazards
- "Addressed in" check: {'ok': True, 'note': "All five artifacts exist in the named documents: 02_interfaces.md:57-97 (F02.2 clock/reset/CDC rules), :10-19 + :41-55 (classes A-F, F02.9 catalog, one signal table per class), 01_overview.md:137-181 (F01.5 + profile mechanism), 03_packet_engine.md:192-246 (F03.7 hazard classes + ordering rules). Two statements in them no longer describe the RTL: 02_interfaces.md:95 'asynchronous assert, synchronous release' (RTL and both guides are synchronous-only: integrator.md:29, hdl-engineer.md:61) and the class-A word contract (02_interfaces.md:101-108, owned by issue #27)."}
- "Verified by" claimed: DIR
- In `hdl/` today: Single core clock: 130 of 130 always_ff are @(posedge clk_i), no second clock input; CDC deliberately outside the tree (hdl/README.md:27-29; docs/guides/integrator.md:24-38). Parameters: top-level parameter block (hdl/top/protocol_processor_top.sv:88-90 and docs/guides/integrator.md section 2). Hazard classes: nine classes in hdl/common/pp_pkg.sv:51-62, full matrix in hdl/packet_engine/KL_pp_scoreboard.sv. NOT landed: (1) the classifier feeding the scoreboard is a stub - hdl/top/protocol_processor_top.sv:1285-1312 ('dispatch-ROM stub ... until the P4 dispatch ROM lands') requests only STREAM_CFG (all ACMP), MAP_CFG (0x002C/0x002D) and RO_SNAPSHOT for EVERYTHING else, so SET_CONFIGURATION is admitted as a read snapshot instead of CFG_BARRIER, and CLOCK_CFG, NAME_WR, LOCK_OP, REGISTRY_OP, IDENTIFY are never requested; the key is the protocol number (:1312), not the stream index / descriptor; 06_aecp_engine.md:968-976 confirms 'no ROM and no generator for it exist'. (2) the rule-(e) deadline kill face is tied off (:852-854). (3) profile mechanism: one column only - hdl/acmp/rom/gen_ltn_rom.py:8-10 'The plain-IEEE column is ABSENT' (recorded product decision; P-EN-PLAIN-IEEE-PROFILE has no RTL consumer).
- In `tb/` today: DIR exists for the module: tb/scoreboard (3705/3705 on 2026-09-18) sweeps the full 9x9 class-pair matrix in both key relations plus 2600 randomized ops against a literal-table model, mutation-proven M1-M4 (tb/scoreboard/README.md:9-56). At the top only the classes the stub can request are graded: tb/pp_top R19a (MAP_CFG held vs an injected ACMP PROBE_TX, tb/pp_top/README.md:103-105). No check drives a CFG_BARRIER, LOCK_OP, REGISTRY_OP, NAME_WR, CLOCK_CFG or IDENTIFY admission through protocol_processor_top, and none could pass today. Parameter shapes: suites build the default shape only (e.g. tb/adp_engine/README.md:57-58); profile: nothing to test.

## What remains

(1) Replace the hz_stub (protocol_processor_top.sv:1285-1312) with the F03.7 class/key assignment per opcode (CFG_BARRIER for SET_CONFIGURATION, STREAM_CFG keyed by stream index for SET_STREAM_FORMAT/INFO + START/STOP, CLOCK_CFG, NAME_WR, LOCK_OP, REGISTRY_OP, IDENTIFY) and grade each class at pp_top. (2) Reconcile 02 section 2 rule 5 (async reset) with the synchronous-only RTL; the class-A word contract is issue #27. (3) Record in F01.5 that P-EN-PLAIN-IEEE-PROFILE has no RTL consumer (as F01.5 already does for P-DESCR-IMAGE-BYTES). The deadline-kill tie-off is counted under GAP-07.

## Acceptance

1. protocol_processor_top assigns every F06.14 state-changing opcode its F03.7 class and key (SET_CONFIGURATION = CFG_BARRIER, per-stream keys for STREAM_CFG, LOCK_OP, REGISTRY_OP, NAME_WR, CLOCK_CFG, IDENTIFY)
2. tb/pp_top grades at least one admission conflict per newly reachable class (for example SET_CONFIGURATION drains an in-flight ACMP hold before executing)
3. 03 section 6 'current top-level classifier' paragraph and 06 section 8 'Dispatch decision' note are updated to the landed shape
4. 02_interfaces.md section 2 rule 5 states the synchronous active-low reset the RTL implements
